text: Program Description Pathogen biology is the study of related to disease microorganisms (including viruses, bacteria, rickettsia, chlamydia, etc.) and parasites (including protozoa, worms, medical arthropods) biology and pathogenic mechanism of interaction between host and science, is of great importance in basic medical subject. With the development of social economy, cultural exchanges between east and west, and the improvement of human life and behavior change and the environment, climate change, the human infectious diseases is "pathogenic spectrum" of major changes, coupled with the pathogen of antibiotic resistance and the discovery of new pathogens factor, human faces with severe challenges in the struggle of pathogenic organisms. Duration 3 years
